retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century music album layout featuring a centered male portrait against a solid blue backdrop with heavy, wide slab-serif typography in the upper left.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male performer in formal attire, positioned slightly off-center against a vibrant blue studio background, with bold, horizontally-extended slab-serif text stacked in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-subject proximity in the upper left corner
Contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool blue background
Vertical alignment of the stacked typography lines
Subject's gaze directed toward the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold yellow/white text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text in the top left, moves to the subject's face, then down the line of the jacket over the shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space surrounding the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white for typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and silver textures in the subject's clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with high-value white/yellow text for maximum legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Alternating colors (yellow and white) within the same font family for visual rhythm.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and mid-century feel.
Geometric slab serif with similar horizontal presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a light blue ruffled shirt and tuxedo vest, holding a jacket over his shoulder, against a solid vibrant blue studio background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of stacked, uppercase, extra-wide slab-serif text in the top left corner, alternating between yellow and white colors.

verificationChecks: Is the text in a heavy slab-serif font?
Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is the text stacked in the upper left corner?
Are the colors yellow and white used for the main title?

avoid: Overlapping text on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serifs are thick and blocky.
Ensure the blue background is uniform and saturated.
Verify the text is left-aligned and stacked.
Confirm the subject is in a medium-shot portrait.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Solid Color Backdrop + Stacked Extended Slab Serif Typography = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
